skills.primaryGoal: Enable authors to produce correct, consistent interfaces using the maintained UI system.
secondaryGoals: Preserve authoritative visual and component semantics.
Make documented behavior reliable in supported conditions.
Keep implementation context inexpensive to retrieve.

kpis.label: System fidelity
kpis.numerator: Applicable styling and composition requirements satisfied
kpis.denominator: Applicable styling and composition requirements inspected
kpis.evidence: Rendered geometry/type/color observations plus source bindings
kpis.boundary: No interaction behavior; visual parity alone is not source fidelity.
kpis.targetPolicy: Set before cohort evaluation; never infer thresholds from observed results.
kpis.aggregation: Separate cohorts by skill/dependency version, task, model/effort, criteria and environment. Do not pool incompatible observations.
kpis.missingPolicy: Not measured; zero denominator is not 0% or 100%.

kpis.label: Interaction correctness
kpis.boundary: No layout checks or environment-count inflation.
kpis.targetPolicy: Set before cohort evaluation; never infer thresholds from observed results.
kpis.aggregation: Separate cohorts by skill/dependency version, task, model/effort, criteria and environment. Do not pool incompatible observations.
kpis.missingPolicy: Not measured; zero denominator is not 0% or 100%.

kpis.label: Environment resilience
kpis.numerator: Required environment cases satisfying usability criteria
kpis.boundary: Report untested required cases separately; not component operation correctness.
kpis.targetPolicy: Set before cohort evaluation; never infer thresholds from observed results.
kpis.aggregation: Separate cohorts by skill/dependency version, task, model/effort, criteria and environment. Do not pool incompatible observations.
kpis.missingPolicy: Not measured; zero denominator is not 0% or 100%.

kpis.label: Standalone consumption success
kpis.numerator: Isolated attempts resolving and building the kit without review dependencies
kpis.denominator: All eligible isolated consumption attempts, including failures/timeouts
kpis.evidence: Fresh workspace logs, dependency identities and build result
kpis.boundary: Build integration only; not application task success.
kpis.targetPolicy: Set before cohort evaluation; never infer thresholds from observed results.
kpis.aggregation: Separate cohorts by skill/dependency version, task, model/effort, criteria and environment. Do not pool incompatible observations.
kpis.missingPolicy: Not measured; zero denominator is not 0% or 100%.

kpis.label: Context retrieval burden
kpis.numerator: Returned context bytes per eligible successful-quality attempt
kpis.denominator: Median across comparable attempts; repeated-byte share is diagnostic
kpis.applicability: Attempts with complete retrieval traces and stated quality gates
kpis.evidence: Exact tool-return bytes, read identities, quality results, model/task settings
kpis.boundary: Not model tokens or total authoring time; include excluded failed attempts alongside.
kpis.targetPolicy: Set before cohort evaluation; never infer thresholds from observed results.
kpis.aggregation: Separate cohorts by skill/dependency version, task, model/effort, criteria and environment. Do not pool incompatible observations.
kpis.missingPolicy: Not measured; zero denominator is not 0% or 100%.

skills.primaryGoal: Help reviewers make an informed component decision by trying meaningful, comparable alternatives.

kpis.label: Decision-relevant distinctness
kpis.numerator: Requested decision axes showing substantive demonstrated contrast
kpis.evidence: Brief-bound human rubric and inspected alternatives
kpis.boundary: No reward for arbitrary visual difference.
kpis.targetPolicy: Set before cohort evaluation; never infer thresholds from observed results.
kpis.aggregation: Separate cohorts by skill/dependency version, task, model/effort, criteria and environment. Do not pool incompatible observations.
kpis.missingPolicy: Not measured; zero denominator is not 0% or 100%.

kpis.label: Comparison fairness
kpis.numerator: Controlled conditions held equal or explicitly varied by the agreed design
kpis.evidence: Fixtures, widths, baseline/asset provenance and intended variation
kpis.boundary: Does not score distinctness or reviewer preference.
kpis.targetPolicy: Set before cohort evaluation; never infer thresholds from observed results.
kpis.aggregation: Separate cohorts by skill/dependency version, task, model/effort, criteria and environment. Do not pool incompatible observations.
kpis.missingPolicy: Not measured; zero denominator is not 0% or 100%.

kpis.label: Preview operability
kpis.targetPolicy: Set before cohort evaluation; never infer thresholds from observed results.
kpis.aggregation: Separate cohorts by skill/dependency version, task, model/effort, criteria and environment. Do not pool incompatible observations.
kpis.missingPolicy: Not measured; zero denominator is not 0% or 100%.

kpis.label: Feedback fidelity
kpis.numerator: Export cases preserving all required identity, notes and correctly labelled context
kpis.evidence: Actual exports, note-time/live context and fallback observations
kpis.boundary: A whole case fails on any required data loss; excludes decision usefulness.
kpis.targetPolicy: Set before cohort evaluation; never infer thresholds from observed results.
kpis.aggregation: Separate cohorts by skill/dependency version, task, model/effort, criteria and environment. Do not pool incompatible observations.
kpis.missingPolicy: Not measured; zero denominator is not 0% or 100%.

kpis.label: Decision usefulness
kpis.numerator: Reviewers reporting a supported choice, combination, rejection or specific next experiment
kpis.denominator: Review sessions with an explicit reviewer response
kpis.evidence: Consent-based short structured reviewer response linked to review revision
kpis.boundary: Missing responses reported separately; selection alone is not usefulness.
kpis.targetPolicy: Set before cohort evaluation; never infer thresholds from observed results.
kpis.aggregation: Separate cohorts by skill/dependency version, task, model/effort, criteria and environment. Do not pool incompatible observations.
kpis.missingPolicy: Not measured; zero denominator is not 0% or 100%.

kpis.label: Review-shell overhead
kpis.numerator: Attributed active authoring effort on comparison apparatus
kpis.denominator: Total attributed active authoring effort for the comparison task
kpis.evidence: Trace segments with declared attribution method
kpis.boundary: Do not infer effort from file mtime, line count or elapsed wall time alone.
kpis.targetPolicy: Set before cohort evaluation; never infer thresholds from observed results.
kpis.aggregation: Separate cohorts by skill/dependency version, task, model/effort, criteria and environment. Do not pool incompatible observations.
kpis.missingPolicy: Not measured; zero denominator is not 0% or 100%.

kpis.targetPolicy: Set before cohort evaluation; never infer thresholds from observed results.
kpis.aggregation: Separate cohorts by skill/dependency version, task, model/effort, criteria and environment. Do not pool incompatible observations.
kpis.missingPolicy: Not measured; zero denominator is not 0% or 100%.

kpis.applicability: Multiple-proposal requests; single proposal is not applicable
kpis.boundary: No reward for variants outside requested scope.

kpis.label: Review interaction correctness

globalRules: Dependency results are linked, not counted twice.
Performance and evidence strength are separate.
Counts of files and tests are not attempt denominators.
